# Report and hand off

**Input:** resume report action, actual run state, source-bound case/check/review/publication receipts and unresolved decisions.

**Read:** [full resume/report policy](../delivery-rules.md#resume-and-report), [human verification](../human-verification.md), and [working PR draft](../working-pr-draft.md) when reporting PR evidence.

**Skills:** use available `pstack:teach` only when the user needs an explanation of existing findings. For unattended/multiphase work, use the existing `show-me-your-work` trail and required independent trail review; preserve its limitation if unavailable.

**Action:** reconcile active owners and current sources before claiming completion. Report actual covered cases, environment, head/check/review status, PR links, blocked cases/owners, grouped publication holds and smallest decisions needed. Separate planned/local fixture/human walkthrough/SIT/deployment evidence. Use the same durable run, decision trail and PR drafts on handoff.

**Output:** concise truthful user report or a fresh scoped handoff with run/context hash, owner, next action, phase card and exact source/evidence pointers.

**Stop/return:** finish when the authorized acceptance predicate is observed or the exact pending boundary is clearly reported. A closed task, passing fixture or local receipt does not prove remote state. No automatic ownership takeover or invented completion; a resumed coordinator runs resume again.
